_comment: Canonical Aether event registry — DO NOT manually edit. Source of truth for packages/shared/events.ts and generated_registry.py. Edit here, then run: python scripts/generate_contracts.py

_registryNotes.runtime_domain_commerce: Dotted commerce.* event types (commerce.order.created, commerce.cart.updated, ...) live in the runtime domain, NOT in this registry, mirroring the comms precedent. WS4 of the UPR follow-on program tracks this split (tracker-only); the merge stays deferred to a dedicated convergence program. No EventType-union edits here.
_registryNotes.field_trust: WS-A2 field-trust taxonomy. Every Contract Spine field carries a trust/authority class; trustClasses above is the canonical rank (array index order). Per-event fieldTrust.fields declares dotted Envelope-A (BaseEvent) payload paths whose class deviates from fieldTrustDefaults; unlisted fields default to OBSERVED / sourceEmit:true / level A. Descriptive in WS-A2; the SDK/ingress boundary is declared in WS-A3: the SDK-assertable boundary is a class SET (sdkBoundary.publicSdk.assertableTrustClasses = OBSERVED/SOURCE_ASSERTED/SOURCE_REFERENCE/CLIENT_HINT), per-event sdkEmitable enumerates the public-SDK-emittable types, and a boundary gate (repo-doctor) enforces self-consistency. Fields are ordered low (observed) to high (operator-asserted) authority; runtime enforcement (flag-gated) lands with the universal gateway in WS-B.
_registryNotes.semantic_levels: WS-A3 semantic Level A/B/C (primitive observation / typed source observation / derived Aether state). Every event carries a per-event semanticLevel; a public SDK key may emit only levels A/B (sdkBoundary.publicSdk.emittableSemanticLevels). Level C is derived Aether state, never public SDK-emitted truth; when represented as an event for internal processing it must carry source=aether_internal, claim_type, model/version and evidence (WS-A5/WS-D).
_registryNotes.sdk_boundary: WS-A3 SDK boundary. sdkBoundary.publicSdk.assertableTrustClasses is the SDK-assertable class SET and per-event sdkEmitable enumerates public-SDK-emittable types (sdkEmitable=true implies semanticLevel A/B). The static boundary gate asserts registry self-consistency; runtime enforcement at the ingestion boundary (flag-gated) is deferred to WS-B's universal gateway.

A.label: Primitive observation
A.notes: Bare instrumentation the SDK records directly (track/page/screen/interaction_observed/api_request_observed).

B.label: Typed source observation
B.notes: A typed observation the emitting source actually saw or asserted (product_viewed/order_completed/agent_tool_invocation_observed/transaction_confirmed_observed).

C.label: Derived Aether state
C.notes: Derived/computed Aether state, not public SDK-emitted truth; internal representation must carry source=aether_internal + claim_type + model/version + evidence (WS-A5/WS-D).

publicSdk.notes: Boundary declared in WS-A3 as a class SET (not a linear rank cut): a public SDK key may originate fields in assertableTrustClasses only; SERVER_STAMPED and above are backend-only and gated at the ingestion boundary. A public SDK key may emit only event types whose per-event sdkEmitable is true, and sdkEmitable events must be semanticLevel A or B.

aetherInternal.notes: Aether-internal publishers may assert any class, including derived Level-C state (with source=aether_internal + claim_type/model/evidence per blueprint). Full per-ingress-path declarations (webhook/connector/feed/service) are WS-B.
